es.title: Moussa Traoré, centímetros y juventud para la pintura del Basket Cervantes
es.description: El Basket Cervantes Ciudad Real ha anunciado la incorporación de Sekou Moussa Traoré para la temporada 2026/27. El jugador maliense, de 21 años y 2,08 metros de altura, reforzará el juego interior del conjunto ciudadrealeño en Tercera FEB. Traoré llega a Ciudad Real con una interesante trayectoria pese a su juventud. Se formó en la cantera de UCAM Murcia , con la que disputó los Campeonatos de España U18 de 2022 y 2023. En la segunda de esas participaciones, el conjunto murciano alcanzó los octavos de final, ronda en la que cayó frente al Valencia Basket. Su etapa en Murcia también le permitió adquirir experiencia internacional. En 2023 participó en la Youth Basketball Champions League , midiéndose a equipos como Hapoel Jerusalem, Oostende o BBA Ludwigsburg. El nuevo jugador del Cervantes firmó unos destacados promedios de 13,8 puntos, 9,2 rebotes y 16,3 de valoración por encuentro . En uno de sus mejores partidos de aquella competición alcanzó los 20 puntos y 11 rebotes para 22 créditos de valoración, además de completar otros dos encuentros con dobles figuras en dos apartados estadísticos. Tras finalizar su etapa de formación, Traoré dio el salto al baloncesto sénior en San Pablo Burgos , donde dispuso de una media de 17 minutos por partido durante la temporada 2023/24. El curso pasado militó en el CB Cuarte de Huerva , aunque una lesión limitó su participación a solo cuatro encuentros y le mantuvo apartado de las pistas durante el resto de la temporada. Ya recuperado, el pívot afrontará ahora una nueva etapa en Ciudad Real. Traoré ha mostrado sus ganas de comenzar esta nueva aventura con el Basket Cervantes: “Vengo con ganas de empezar la temporada y ayudar al equipo a estar donde merece y quiero ayudar como jugador y como persona” .

mx.title: La famosa materia oscura ya está aquí: el misterioso evento detectado bajo tierra que enciende las alarmas
mx.description: Hay un tipo de materia que los científicos llevan casi un siglo intentando encontrar y que, pese a dar forma a al 85 % de la materia del universo , nunca ha podido observarse directamente. Ahora, un equipo internacional ha encontrado algo que encaja con una de las hipótesis que se utilizan para buscarla: una interacción de partículas difícil de explicar con los fenómenos de fondo conocidos. El hallazgo procede del experimento LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ), uno de los detectores de materia oscura más sensibles construidos hasta la fecha. El resultado es lo suficientemente interesante como para haber llamado la atención de la comunidad científica, pero todavía no se puede afirmar que se haya dado con la tecla. El análisis, realizado durante dos años por unos 250 científicos e ingenieros de 39 instituciones de seis países, ha encontrado un único evento en la región en la que podría esperarse una señal producida por una partícula de materia oscura. La señal alcanza una significación estadística de 2,6 sigma , todavía lejos de los 5 sigma que normalmente exige la física de partículas para hablar de un descubrimiento. Evento único El interés del resultado está precisamente en que los investigadores han encontrado una interacción que resulta complicada de atribuir a las señales de fondo conocidas. En otras palabras, después de aplicar los filtros para eliminar posibles interferencias, ha quedado un evento especialmente llamativo. El trabajo ha sido presentado por el doctor Sam Eriksen, de la Universidad de Bristol, durante la conferencia TeV Particle Astrophysics 2026 celebrada en Japón. Según explicó el investigador, podría tratarse de un primer paso hacia la comprensión de la materia oscura como una partícula. Pero los propios responsables del experimento han pedido cautela. Rick Gaitskell, profesor de la Universidad Brown y miembro de la colaboración LZ, señaló que no quieren adelantarse a las conclusiones porque solo se ha observado un evento. Esta prudencia es especialmente importante en física experimental. Una señal aislada puede terminar siendo una fluctuación estadística o proceder de algún fenómeno que todavía no se haya identificado correctamente. Para convertir una anomalía en evidencia sólida, hace falta observar que el fenómeno se repite con nuevos datos. Ahora mismo, con los datos recogidos, todavía existe una posibilidad apreciable de que el evento tenga una explicación convencional. SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory @SLAClab Could this unexpected signal be our first detection of dark matter? th.description: นายอําเภอแม่แจ่ม บูรณาการภาคีเครือข่ายลงพื้นที่หย่อมบ้านสันปูเลย – บ้านกองบอด ระดมเครื่องจักร-กําลังคน ปรับสภาพผิวถนนลูกรัง สัญจรลําบากในฤดูฝน วันที่ 3 กันยายน 2569 เวลา 10.30 น. นายเกรียงศักดิ์ บุญตาปวน นายอําเภอแม่แจ่ม ลงพื้นที่หย่อมบ้านสันปูเลย – บ้านกองบอด ม.11 ต.ปางหินฝน อ.แม่แจ่ม จ.เชียงใหม่ เนื่องจากผู้ช่วยผู้ใหญ่บ้านหย่อมสันปูเลยขอความอนุเคราะห์อําเภอสนับสนุนงบประมาณในการจัดหาเครื่องจักรในการปรับผิวถนนลูกรังที่เป็นทางสัญจรเข้า-ออก หมู่บ้าน ที่ขณะนี้ชาวบ้านได้รับควาทเดือนร้อนเป็นอย่างมาก ปัจจุบันถนนเชื่อมหย่อมบ้านสันปูเลยนั้น สภาพเป็นถนนดินลูกรังในฤดูฝน ชาวบ้านได้รับความเดือดร้อนจากฝนที่ตกหนัก รถติดหล่มไม่สามารถขนส่งผลผลิตทางการเกษตรหรือการเข้าถึงระบบบริการสาธารณสุขเป็นไปด้วยความยากลําบาก เพื่อเป็นการบรรเทาความเดือดร้อนของราษฎรและอํานวยความสะดวกในการขนส่งผลผลิตทางการเกษตร การเข้าถึงระบบสาธารณสุข ได้อย่างทันท่วงที นายอําเภอแม่แจ่ม จึงประสานไปยังภาคีเครือข่ายในการสนับสนุนงบประมาณในการจัดหาเครื่องจักรในการปรับผิวถนนและลงพื้นที่เยี่ยมให้กําลังใจผู้นําชุมชน ชาวบ้านจิตอาสา ที่ช่วยกันปรับสภาพผิวถนนให้ชาวบ้านสามารถสัญจรได้ ทั้งนี้ นายอําเภอแม่แจ่มได้ประสานไปยังองค์การบริหารส่วนตําบลปางหินฝนและองค์การบริหารส่วนจังหวัดเชียงใหม่ ในการแก้ไขปัญหาการคมนาคมและยกระดับคุณภาพชีวิตของราษฎรในถิ่นทุรกันดารอย่างยั่งยืน “การขับเคลื่อนโครงการก่อสร้างถนนคอนกรีตเสริมเหล็ก (คสล.) ทดแทนถนนลูกรัง” ที่ช่วยลดเวลาในการเดินทาง ขจัดปัญหาฝุ่นละอองในฤดูแล้ง และแก้ปัญหาทางดินโคลนที่เป็นอุปสรรคต่อการสัญจรในฤดูฝน ทั้งนี้ฃอําเภอแม่แจ่มได้รับการสนับสนุนจาก องค์การบริหารส่วนตําบลปางหินฝน ที่สนับสนุนเครื่องจักรในการปรับเกลี่ยผิวถนน สจ.บุญนงค์ สุริยะชัยพันธุ์ และมูลนิธิรักกัน ที่สนับสนุนงบประมาณ เพื่อใช้ในการช่วยเหลือและบรรเทาให้กับชาวบ้าน Source

ph.title: LITEON Announces Strategic Investment in Liquid Cooling Technology Company DCX
ph.description: Advancing AI Infrastructure Value Chain Through Integrated Power Management and Cooling Technologies TAIPEI , Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- LITEON Technology (2301.TW) today announced a strategic investment in DCX POLSKA Sp. z o.o. ("DCX Liquid Cooling Systems"), a Warsaw, Poland-based provider of advanced liquid cooling systems for AI and High-Performance Computing (HPC) data cente rs. Upon closing of the transaction, LITEON will hold approximately 25% equity ownership in DCX Liquid Cooling Systems with a total transaction value of approximately US$176 million. The investment brings together DCX's deep expertise in liquid cooling technologies, including coolant distribution units (CDUs), facility coolant distribution units (FDUs), cold plates and immersion cooling systems, with LITEON's strengths in AI server power management, rack-level power delivery and 800VDC power architectures. Together, the two companies are positioned to deliver highly integrated power and thermal management solutions for the rapidly evolving AI infrastructure and next-generation high-density computing market. The accelerating adoption of AI applications is driving unprecedented rack power densities, making liquid cooling a critical enabling technology for future-ready data centers and high-performance computing. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, DCX Liquid Cooling Systems has established itself as a leading innovator in direct-to-chip and immersion liquid cooling, with advanced design and integration capabilities in liquid cooling infrastructure for data centers, offering a complete portfolio ranging from enterprise-level coolant distribution units (600kW–2.6MW) to hyperscale-class facility coolant distribution units (up to 16MW), as well as cold plates, rack manifolds and modular data center systems. Through this strategic partnership, LITEON and DCX Liquid Cooling Systems will expand collaboration across product development, engineering innovation, manufacturing scale-up, and global go-to-market initiatives. The companies will jointly develop integrated power-and-cooling platforms designed to address the increasing performance and efficiency demands of the hyperscale data center customers worldwide. "AI has become a key force reshaping industries, and data center infrastructure is a critical foundation for unlocking AI's full potential," said Tom Soong, Chairman of LITEON. "As we continue to invest in advanced technologies, this strategic investment further strengthens LITEON's position across the AI data center value chain. Through this partnership, we look forward to advancing innovation and creating new possibilities in the rapidly expanding AI market. LITEON will continue to engage with global partners that possess deep technological expertise and strong strategic synergies, strengthening cross-domain technology integration through both strategic investments and long-term collaboration. By bringing together complementary capabilities across the AI data center value chain, we aim to advance a more resilient and comprehensive AI infrastructure ecosystem, expand system-level solution capabilities, and create sustainable competitive advantages for the next era of computing." Maciek Szadkowski , Chief Technology Officer at DCX Liquid Cooling Systems, added, "LITEON's deep expertise in power electronics, global manufacturing scale, and long-standing hyperscaler relationships make it a highly strategic partner for DCX. We regard this alliance as both an obligation and a commitment - to deliver the best, state-of-the-art technology for our strategic partner and for the world-class customers. This partnership will accelerate our global growth and combine the strengths of both companies to deliver broad next-generation data center infrastructure solutions." "LITEON is a partner whose global scale and engineering heritage we deeply respect, and we are proud that our liquid cooling technology will help to shape what they bring to the world's data centers. Together we can offer operators a single integrated solution, ready for the next generation of AI computing platforms and beyond." said Tomasz Buk, Chief Executive Officer at DCX Liquid Cooling Systems.

("DCX Liquid Cooling Systems"), a Warsaw, Poland-based provider of advanced liquid cooling systems for AI and High-Performance Computing (HPC) data cente rs. Upon closing of the transaction, LITEON will hold approximately 25% equity ownership in DCX Liquid Cooling Systems with a total transaction value of approximately US$176 million. The investment brings together DCX's deep expertise in liquid cooling technologies, including coolant distribution units (CDUs), facility coolant distribution units (FDUs), cold plates and immersion cooling systems, with LITEON's strengths in AI server power management, rack-level power delivery and 800VDC power architectures. Together, the two companies are positioned to deliver highly integrated power and thermal management solutions for the rapidly evolving AI infrastructure and next-generation high-density computing market. The accelerating adoption of AI applications is driving unprecedented rack power densities, making liquid cooling a critical enabling technology for future-ready data centers and high-performance computing. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, DCX Liquid Cooling Systems has established itself as a leading innovator in direct-to-chip and immersion liquid cooling, with advanced design and integration capabilities in liquid cooling infrastructure for data centers, offering a complete portfolio ranging from enterprise-level coolant distribution units (600kW–2.6MW) to hyperscale-class facility coolant distribution units (up to 16MW), as well as cold plates, rack manifolds and modular data center systems. Through this strategic partnership, LITEON and DCX Liquid Cooling Systems will expand collaboration across product development, engineering innovation, manufacturing scale-up, and global go-to-market initiatives. The companies will jointly develop integrated power-and-cooling platforms designed to address the increasing performance and efficiency demands of the hyperscale data center customers worldwide. "AI has become a key force reshaping industries, and data center infrastructure is a critical foundation for unlocking AI's full potential," said Tom Soong, Chairman of LITEON. "As we continue to invest in advanced technologies, this strategic investment further strengthens LITEON's position across the AI data center value chain. Through this partnership, we look forward to advancing innovation and creating new possibilities in the rapidly expanding AI market. LITEON will continue to engage with global partners that possess deep technological expertise and strong strategic synergies, strengthening cross-domain technology integration through both strategic investments and long-term collaboration. By bringing together complementary capabilities across the AI data center value chain, we aim to advance a more resilient and comprehensive AI infrastructure ecosystem, expand system-level solution capabilities, and create sustainable competitive advantages for the next era of computing." Maciek Szadkowski , Chief Technology Officer at DCX Liquid Cooling Systems, added, "LITEON's deep expertise in power electronics, global manufacturing scale, and long-standing hyperscaler relationships make it a highly strategic partner for DCX. We regard this alliance as both an obligation and a commitment - to deliver the best, state-of-the-art technology for our strategic partner and for the world-class customers. This partnership will accelerate our global growth and combine the strengths of both companies to deliver broad next-generation data center infrastructure solutions." "LITEON is a partner whose global scale and engineering heritage we deeply respect, and we are proud that our liquid cooling technology will help to shape what they bring to the world's data centers. Together we can offer operators a single integrated solution, ready for the next generation of AI computing platforms and beyond." said Tomasz Buk, Chief Executive Officer at DCX Liquid Cooling Systems.

bd.title: Narwal Expands AI-Powered Cleaning Across the Home as IFA 2026 Returns to Berlin
bd.description: Flagship FlowWash Track-Mopping Technology Reaches More Homes with the Freo 20 and Freo 20 Edge BERLIN , Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Narwal , a global AI-powered cleaning expert and pioneer in robotic mopping technology, today unveiled its 2026 Fall Lineup during IFA , introducing new robotic and handheld cleaning solutions. Building on a decade of innovation, Narwal is expanding its expertise across a broader portfolio designed to meet a wider range of cleaning needs and homes. At the heart of this evolution is Narwal's FlowWash Mopping System , which now extends from the flagship Flow series into the Freo family through the new Freo 20 and Freo 20 Edge . The Flow 2 , recently refreshed in a new white color palette, continues to showcase the highest expression of this mopping technology. The showcase also featured the Narwal V50 Cube and offered a first look at the company's upcoming wet & dry vacuum solutions. "For a decade, we've focused on making mopping truly effective in robotic cleaning. The Flow 2 represents the pinnacle of that journey, and with this new lineup, we're bringing the expertise behind it to more homes while expanding into new cleaning categories," said Junbin Zhang, Founder and CEO of Narwal , who joined media and industry stakeholders for Narwal's exclusive media experience in Berlin. FlowWash: Solving One of the Hardest Challenges in Robot Cleaning While robotic vacuum technology has advanced rapidly, effective mopping remains a major industry challenge. Narwal developed the FlowWash Mopping System to turn mopping from simple wiping into a continuous process that refreshes and cleans the mop in real time. FlowWash brings together three core technologies: Track Mop Design: The microfiber flattened roller mop provides nearly seven times more contact area than traditional roller mop designs, delivering more consistent floor contact and effective stain removal. 60°C Continuous Hot-Water Cleaning: A 16-nozzle angled water distribution system continuously refreshes the mop with 60°C hot water during cleaning, while an integrated scraper removes dirt and wastewater in real time. 12N Cleaning Pressure: The roller applies 12N of downward pressure to maintain stable floor contact and support effective scrubbing across different surfaces. Bringing this technology beyond flagship products required overcoming significant engineering challenges, including precise dual-shaft synchronization, fabric tension control, and pressure management. Through years of research and development, Narwal successfully scaled this advanced mopping technology into a more accessible product category. Freo Series: Bringing Flagship Cleaning Innovation to More Homes The Freo series represents Narwal's commitment to making intelligent cleaning technology accessible to a wider range of consumers, bringing the engineering and performance of its flagship innovations into more accessible solutions. Narwal Freo 20 — Premium Solution for Complex Homes The Narwal Freo 20 marks a major milestone for the Freo family as the first model to feature Narwal's flagship FlowWash Mopping System . Designed for families with children, pets, and busy households, Freo 20 combines flagship mopping performance with AI-powered intelligence to deliver effortless whole-home cleaning with minimal maintenance. Key highlights include: FlowWash 60°C hot water real-time self-cleaning mopping technology 31,000 Pa suction power NarMindTM Pro Autonomous System with dual RGB cameras AI recognition of more than 300 household objects DualFlow Tangle-Free System and EdgeReach Technology With its refined woven-texture dock design and automated maintenance features, Freo 20 brings flagship-level cleaning performance into a broader segment of homes. Narwal Freo 20 Edge — Intelligent Cleaning Made Simple The Narwal Freo 20 Edge makes Narwal's intelligent cleaning experience more accessible, combining reliable performance with streamlined automation for effortless everyday cleaning. Designed for apartments and less demanding home environments, it delivers consistently clean floors without advanced AI-powered clutter recognition. Key highlights include: FlowWash real-time self-cleaning mopping technology 31,000 Pa suction power DualFlow Tangle-Free System and EdgeReach Technology Hidden dToF LiDAR and Dual-Sided Structured Light 3D navigation Ultra-slim 9.5 cm body design for low-clearance cleaning All-in-one dock with auto dust emptying and 45°C hot air drying With its balanced combination of smart cleaning performance, essential automation, and streamlined functionality, Freo 20 Edge offers dependable, hands-free cleaning for modern everyday living. Beyond Robots: Creating Better Human-Controlled Cleaning Experiences While robot vacuums have transformed everyday floor care, some cleaning tasks still require the precision and flexibility of manual cleaning. Building on its expertise in intelligent floor care, Narwal is expanding into handheld solutions designed to make these tasks easier through thoughtful engineering, automated maintenance, and ergonomic design. Narwal V50 Cube — Ultra-Compact & Effortless Daily Cleaning The Narwal V50 Cube combines an ultra-compact auto-empty dock with lightweight, powerful performance to deliver effortless everyday cleaning in a space-saving design. Designed for modern homes that want maximum efficiency in a space-saving footprint, the V50 Cube eliminates manual hassle with its intelligent auto-empty dock. Ultra-Compact Auto-Empty Dock: Space-saving base station with automated dust disposal, ideal for apartments and multi-level homes. Maintenance-Free Experience: Automated dust emptying with 9-Layer Filtration minimizes manual maintenance and keeps hands clean. 1.4 kg Lightweight & Ergonomic Handling: Easy to carry and maneuver for seamless floor-to-ceiling cleaning. Whole-Home Cleaning Versatility: Specialized tools for floors, carpets, furniture, upholstery, and tight corners. Powerful Pet Hair & Dirt Pickup: 210AW high suction performance designed to tackle stubborn debris and pet hair. Narwal Wet & Dry Vacuum Series — Intelligent Deep Cleaning Beyond Robotics Narwal also previewed its upcoming wet & dry vacuum lineup , planned for launch in Europe in 2027. The portfolio will include both an Essential Model for everyday floor care and a Flagship Model showcasing Narwal's latest wet & dry cleaning innovations. Key highlights of the Flagship Model include: 400°C steam and 95°C hot-water mopping technology for advanced stain removal and hygienic floor care 25,000 Pa suction power for deeper cleaning performance Floating Scraper technology for tangle-free, streak-free cleaning AI DirtSense technology that automatically adapts cleaning power based on floor conditions 180° flat-lie design, triple-sided edge cleaning, and up to 40 minutes run-time in AI mode The new lineup extends Narwal's intelligent cleaning portfolio into new floor-care scenarios, combining advanced cleaning technologies with thoughtful engineering for greater cleaning flexibility. Price and Availability The new Fall lineup will begin rolling out across European markets in September 2026, bringing Narwal's latest cleaning innovations to consumers across different product categories. The upcoming wet & dry vacuum range will further expand the portfolio in 2027, with launch details to follow. bd.title: AWOL Vision Debuts LuxVision at IFA 2026: World's First 4K 120Hz UST with Optical Shift
bd.description: BERLIN , Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AWOL Vision, a global home entertainment brand delivering immersive audiovisual experiences through large-format displays, home cinema technology, and connected entertainment. Centered around its new vision, "Bring Wonder Home," the upgrade brings the AWOL Aetherion Series for ultra-short-throw projectors and AWOL Valerion Series for long-throw projectors under one cohesive AWOL Vision brand framework. Joining the AWOL Aetherion Series in the ultra-short-throw lineup, AWOL LuxVision debuts as the brand's new flagship projector for premium home entertainment and home theater spaces. The world's first 4K 120Hz ultra-short-throw projector with optical shift , it combines 6000 ISO lumens, RGB triple-laser projection, a 0.18:1 throw ratio, and support for screen sizes up to 200 inches - delivering flagship-grade, large-format home entertainment in one seamless experience. AWOL LuxVision: Nothing Between You and the Moment At the heart of LuxVision is 4K at 120 frames per second, processing nearly one billion pixels every second to keep fast-moving scenes sharp, smooth, and naturally detailed — whether it's a game-winning play, a high-speed racing sequence, or an action-packed movie. For gamers, that speed pairs with 1ms input lag , ALLM, VRR, and Dolby Vision Gaming, while three HDMI 2.1 ports, a DisplayPort, and 4-channel HDMI Multiview make it easy to bring multiple screens and sources into the moment. With 6000 ISO Lumens of RGB triple-laser brightness, LuxVision keeps big-screen color vivid from bright daylight to late-night movies. 110% Rec. 2020 coverage, Dynamic Tone Mapping, and a 7-level dynamic IRIS fine-tune color, contrast, and light scene by scene, while Dolby Vision, IMAX Enhanced, Filmmaker Mode, and 3D support deepen the cinematic experience across every type of content. Optical performance gives LuxVision another level of flexibility. A 0.18:1 throw ratio turns an ultra-short distance into up to 200 inches of cinematic scale, while one-touch vertical optical lens shift lets you position the image exactly where it belongs — with true 4K detail fully intact. A motorized lens cover and zero-light-leakage lens keep the picture pure, aligned, and free of distraction. Built on the natural smoothness of 4K 120Hz, AWOL's second-generation Anti-RBE technology combines an optimized algorithm that covers all formats with TÜV Harmful Light Reduction, minimizing visible rainbow artifacts and visual fatigue for cleaner, more comfortable viewing across 2D and 3D content — especially in fast, high-contrast scenes. Beyond performance, LuxVision is designed to belong in the home. Inspired by the architectural harmony of the Parthenon, LuxVision transforms classical column rhythm into a sculptural, modern UST form that feels refined in any room. With customizable CMF options, its color, material, and finish can be tailored to complement the mood and character of different living spaces. Together, these technologies are designed around a simple idea: true immersion is not just about making the screen bigger, but about removing the distractions between the viewer and the experience. With LuxVision, there is Nothing Between You and the Moment. AWOL Vision's projector portfolio covers two core lines: the Valerion Series for premium long-throw projection, and the Aetherion and LuxVision Series for premium ultra-short-throw projection. ae.title: LITEON Announces Strategic Investment in Liquid Cooling Technology Company DCX
ae.description: Advancing AI Infrastructure Value Chain Through Integrated Power Management and Cooling Technologies TAIPEI , Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- LITEON Technology (2301.TW) today announced a strategic investment in DCX POLSKA Sp. z o.o. ("DCX Liquid Cooling Systems"), a Warsaw, Poland-based provider of advanced liquid cooling systems for AI and High-Performance Computing (HPC) data cente rs. Upon closing of the transaction, LITEON will hold approximately 25% equity ownership in DCX Liquid Cooling Systems with a total transaction value of approximately US$176 million. The investment brings together DCX's deep expertise in liquid cooling technologies, including coolant distribution units (CDUs), facility coolant distribution units (FDUs), cold plates and immersion cooling systems, with LITEON's strengths in AI server power management, rack-level power delivery and 800VDC power architectures. Together, the two companies are positioned to deliver highly integrated power and thermal management solutions for the rapidly evolving AI infrastructure and next-generation high-density computing market. The accelerating adoption of AI applications is driving unprecedented rack power densities, making liquid cooling a critical enabling technology for future-ready data centers and high-performance computing. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, DCX Liquid Cooling Systems has established itself as a leading innovator in direct-to-chip and immersion liquid cooling, with advanced design and integration capabilities in liquid cooling infrastructure for data centers, offering a complete portfolio ranging from enterprise-level coolant distribution units (600kW–2.6MW) to hyperscale-class facility coolant distribution units (up to 16MW), as well as cold plates, rack manifolds and modular data center systems. Through this strategic partnership, LITEON and DCX Liquid Cooling Systems will expand collaboration across product development, engineering innovation, manufacturing scale-up, and global go-to-market initiatives. The companies will jointly develop integrated power-and-cooling platforms designed to address the increasing performance and efficiency demands of the hyperscale data center customers worldwide. "AI has become a key force reshaping industries, and data center infrastructure is a critical foundation for unlocking AI's full potential," said Tom Soong, Chairman of LITEON. "As we continue to invest in advanced technologies, this strategic investment further strengthens LITEON's position across the AI data center value chain. Through this partnership, we look forward to advancing innovation and creating new possibilities in the rapidly expanding AI market. LITEON will continue to engage with global partners that possess deep technological expertise and strong strategic synergies, strengthening cross-domain technology integration through both strategic investments and long-term collaboration. By bringing together complementary capabilities across the AI data center value chain, we aim to advance a more resilient and comprehensive AI infrastructure ecosystem, expand system-level solution capabilities, and create sustainable competitive advantages for the next era of computing." Maciek Szadkowski , Chief Technology Officer at DCX Liquid Cooling Systems, added, "LITEON's deep expertise in power electronics, global manufacturing scale, and long-standing hyperscaler relationships make it a highly strategic partner for DCX. We regard this alliance as both an obligation and a commitment - to deliver the best, state-of-the-art technology for our strategic partner and for the world-class customers. This partnership will accelerate our global growth and combine the strengths of both companies to deliver broad next-generation data center infrastructure solutions." "LITEON is a partner whose global scale and engineering heritage we deeply respect, and we are proud that our liquid cooling technology will help to shape what they bring to the world's data centers. Together we can offer operators a single integrated solution, ready for the next generation of AI computing platforms and beyond." said Tomasz Buk, Chief Executive Officer at DCX Liquid Cooling Systems.

sa.title: الاتحاد يعلن التعاقد مع ريتشارد ريوس
sa.description:
أعلن نادي الاتحاد اليوم الخميس رسميًا تعاقده مع الكولومبي ريتشارد ريوس قادمًا من بنفيكا البرتغالي؛ لتدعيم خط الوسط خلال الموسم الجديد.

وتوصل الاتحاد إلى اتفاق لاستعارة ريوس حتى نهاية موسم 2026-2027 دون وجود بند أحقية شراء، ليعود اللاعب إلى بنفيكا الصيف المقبل.

ويأتي ضم ريوس لتعويض رحيل البرازيلي فابينيو بعد مغادرة الفرنسي نجولو كانتي ضمن خطة النادي لإعادة بناء خط الوسط.

ولفت ريوس الأنظار مع بالميراس خلال كأس العالم للأندية 2025، قبل انتقاله إلى بنفيكا مقابل 27 مليون يورو حيث خاض 51 مباراة تحت قيادة جوزيه مورينيو، سجل خلالها 8 أهداف وصنع 6.

ويجيد اللاعب الكولومبي، البالغ 26 عامًا، اللعب في مراكز الوسط 6 و8 و10 ما يمنح الاتحاد خيارات متعددة في خط الوسط.

sa.title: نائب أمير المنطقة الشرقية يطّلع على جهود وأعمال برنامج مستشفى قوى الأمن بالدمام
sa.description:
اطّلع صاحب السمو الملكي الأمير سعود بن بندر بن عبدالعزيز نائب أمير المنطقة الشرقية، على أبرز جهود وأعمال برنامج مستشفى قوى الأمن بالدمام، وذلك خلال استقبال سموه في مكتبه بديوان الإمارة اليوم الخميس، المشرف على برنامج مستشفى قوى الأمن بالدمام والمراكز والعيادات المرتبطة به، الدكتور محمد بن ظافر الأحمري، يرافقه عدد من القيادات.
وأكد سمو نائب أمير المنطقة الشرقية أن ما يحظى به القطاع الصحي من دعم واهتمام من القيادة الرشيدة -أيدها الله- أسهم في تعزيز قدراته وتطوير خدماته، والارتقاء بمستوى الرعاية الصحية والوقائية، ورفع كفاءة المنظومة الصحية، بما يلبي احتياجات المستفيدين، ويعزز جودة الخدمات المقدمة وسلامتها.
وقدّم الأحمري لسمو نائب أمير المنطقة الشرقية عرضاً عن أبرز أعمال وجهود المستشفى والمراكز والعيادات المرتبطة به، ومؤشرات الأداء والخدمات المقدمة، إلى جانب ما يقدمه مركز عزم للتمكين النفسي والمجتمعي، بالإضافة إلى المبادرات والمشروعات التطويرية والاعتمادات والإنجازات النوعية، والمشروعات الجاري تنفيذها لتطوير الخدمات التخصصية، ورفع كفاءة الأداء، وتحسين جودة الرعاية الصحية وتجربة المستفيد.
وأعرب الأحمري عن شكره وتقديره لسمو نائب أمير المنطقة الشرقية على اهتمامه ومتابعته، مؤكدًا مواصلة البرنامج جهوده في تنفيذ مشروعاته التطويرية، وتطوير خدماته، والارتقاء بجودة الرعاية الصحية المقدمة للمستفيدين.

sa.title: الجمعة .. الهلال يلتقي الشباب للحفاظ على الصدارة
sa.description:
يدافع الهلال عن صدارته، عندما يواجه جاره ومضيفه الشباب، يوم غد الجمعة على ملعب إس إتش جي أرينا بالرياض، لحساب منافسات الجولة الخامسة لدوري روشن السعودي .

ويتفوق الهلال تاريخياً على منافسه في دوري المحترفين، إذ إلتقيا 36 مرة، فاز الهلال في 21 مباراة، مقابل فوز الشباب في 5 مباريات، والتعادل في 10 مباريات، سجل خلالها هجوم الهلال 67 هدفاً، في حين سجل هجوم الشباب 37 هدفًا.

ويحتل الشباب المركز الثالث عشر بثلاث نقاط، جمعها من ثلاثة تعادلات والخسارة في مباراة، بينما يتربع الهلال على الصدارة بالعلامة الكاملة، وبفارق الأهداف عن النصر، إثر فوزه في جميع مبارياته.

ورغم الإضافات التي قام بها الشباب، في الميركاتو، إلا أنه فشل في تحقيق أي فوز، ويأمل هذا المساء في تسجيل فوزه الأول أو على الأقل الخروج بنقطة التعادل رغم صعوبة المهمة.

ويبرز في صفوفه الشباب، قائده البلجيكي يانيك كاراسكو والإنجليزي جوش براونهيل والفرنسي ياسين عدلي والكرواتي تين يدفاي والكولومبي روجير مارتينيز والبرتغالي دانيل بودينسي، لكنه يفتقد لجهود الغاني توماس بارتي للإصابة وضاري العنزي للإيقاف.

في المقابل، قدم الهلال نفسه بشكل مميز في مبارياته الماضية خصوصاً أمام الخليج والأهلي، ويطمح الليلة في تحقيق فوزه الخامسة توالياً والبقاء في الصدارة، لاسيما في ظل تكامل صفوفه التي قد تشهد انضمام الوافد الجديد البرازيلي مارتينيلي.

ويضم الهلال نخبة من الأسماء المميزة، منهم البرتغالي روبن نيفيز والصربي سيرجي سافيتش والمغربي ياسين بونو والفرنسي ثيو هيرنانديز والهولندي كريسينسيو سامرفيل، والإنجليزي أولي واتكينز ومحمد محزري وسلطان مندش .

tr.title: Dzeko milli takım kariyerini noktaladı
tr.description: Almanya'nın Schalke 04 ekibinde forma giyen Bosna Hersekli futbolcu Edin Dzeko, milli takım kariyerini sonlandırma kararı aldı. Dzeko , ABD merkezli sosyal medya platformu Instagram hesabından yaptığı paylaşımda, 2 Ekim'de oynanacak Bosna-Hersek-İsveç maçıyla milli takım kariyerini noktalayacağını açıkladı. 40 yaşındaki santrfor yaptığı açıklamada "Çocukluk hayalimdi. Ülkemi futbol sahasında temsil etme onuruna eriştiğim 151 maçın her birinde yanımda taşıdığım bir hayal. Bunu yapmaktan her zaman gurur duydum, tıpkı ilk kez olduğu gibi. Türkiye'ye karşı oynadığımız o maçtan bu yana neredeyse 20 yıl geçti. Birçok şey değişti, ben de değiştim ama bu formaya olan sevgim asla değişmedi." ifadelerini kullandı. Artık futbolu bırakma zamanının geldiğini ifade eden Dzeko, şunları kaydetti: "Şimdi kenara çekilme zamanının geldiğini hissediyorum. Milli takımla 40 yaşına kadar geldiysem, bunun nedeni gerçekten her şeyimi vermiş olmamdır. Ülkem için oynamak, futbolun bana verdiği en duygusal fırsat oldu. 2014'te ilk kez Dünya Kupası'na katılmaya hak kazanmak, bir futbolcu olarak hayatımın en mutlu anlarından biri olmaya devam ediyor. Galler'e karşı attığım golün ve ardından İtalya'ya karşı attığım golün gecesinde hissettiğim duygular sonsuza dek kalbimde kalacak. Şehirlerimizin sokaklarında halkımın kutlamalarını görmek, futbolun bana verdiği bir başka inanılmaz hediyeydi. Bu harika yolculuk boyunca yanımda olan ve beni destekleyen herkese teşekkür etmek için zaman olacak. Şimdilik, İsveç'e karşı o gece orada olmanızı umuyorum. Böylece bir duyguyu daha paylaşabiliriz. Çünkü bu inanılmaz anların her birini birlikte yaşadık. Ülkemi temsil ettiğim son gecemi de tam olarak böyle yaşamak istiyorum. Hepiniz yanımda, çocukluğumdan beri sevdiğim ve hayatımın geri kalanında da sevmeye devam edeceğim formayı üzerimde taşıyarak."

tn.title: بقدرة إنتاجية تبلغ 75 ميغاواط: اختيار مشروع لإنتاج الطاقة من الرياح بالفحص للاستفادة من منحة يابانية
tn.description: أعلنت سفارة اليابان في تونس، عن اختيار مشروع لإنتاج الطاقة من الرياح بالفحص، من ولاية زغوان، بقدرة إنتاجية تبلغ 75 ميغاواط، رسميا، خلال شهر جويلية 2026، للاستفادة من منحة من الحكومة اليابانية، وذلك في إطار آلية تبادل أرصدة الكربون (MCC) القائمة على المادة السادسة من إتفاق باريس للمناخ. وسيتم تنفيذ المشروع من قبل شركة مشتركة يابانية-نرويجية تضم شركة Eurus Energy Holdings Corporation، بصفتها الجهة المستفيدة من آلية تبادل أرصدة الكربون، وشركة Scatec. ومن المنتظر أن تساهم المنشآت المزمع إقامتها في الفحص في خفض إنبعاثات الغازات المسببة للإحتباس الحراري بنحو 88 ألفا و367 طنا من مكافئ ثاني أكسيد الكربون سنويا، وفق المعطيات التي أوردتها السفارة اليابانية. وكانت آلية تبادل أرصدة الكربون قد مكنت، خلال شهر أفريل 2026، من دخول محطتين للطاقة الشمسية الكهروضوئية حيز التشغيل، بطاقة إنتاج تبلغ 50 ميغاواط لكل منهما، في ولايتي توزر وسيدي بوزيد. كما تتواصل، في إطار الآلية ذاتها، مشاريع أخرى للطاقة الشمسية، من بينها مشروع بقدرة 100 ميغاواط في سيدي بوزيد لا يزال في مرحلة التطوير، إلى جانب مشروع بقدرة 130 ميغاواط في قابس، تم اختياره خلال شهر فيفري 2026. وتندرج هذه المشاريع ضمن الجهود الرامية إلى تعزيز قدرة تونس على إنتاج الطاقات المتجددة ودعم التحول الطاقي والحد من انبعاثات الغازات المسببة للاحتباس الحراري. كما من شأن هذه الإستثمارات، وإن كانت مساهمتها في التشغيل لا تزال محدودة، أن توفر فرص عمل خلال مراحل إنجاز المشاريع، وكذلك في أنشطة التشغيل والصيانة بعد دخولها حيز الاستغلال.
